paper.title_en: Role of reaction mechanisms in deuteron-proton elastic scattering at GeV energies
paper.abstract_en: The deuteron-proton elastic scattering process is considered within the relativistic expansion framework. Four reaction mechanisms are taken into account: one-nucleon-exchange,single-scattering, double-scattering terms, and delta-isobar excitation in the intermediate state. The model calculates the reaction amplitude, which makes it possible to find the angular dependenceof both the differential cross section and any polarization observables. In this report, I present thedeuteron and proton analyzing powers, as well as the proton-to-proton polarization transfers in comparisonwith the existing data at the deuteron energy of 1.6 GeV.
